title: BackendSetError/BackendChangesError envelopes separate per-item errors from storage errors
description: backend.rs:155-178 — the distinction between SetError (a JMAP-level per-item error placed in notCreated/notUpdated/notDestroyed) and Other(E) (a storage error that becomes a protocol-level serverFail) is correct. Future contributors might flatten these. The two are semantically different: one is a client error, one is a server error.
